item.title: Screen Australia announces $1.4 million to support 26 games projects, unveils Future Leaders delegation - IF Magazine
item.description: Screen Australia has today announced $1.4 million across 26 projects from the Games Production and Emerging Gamemakers funds, supporting the creation of original games centred on Australian stories and ideas.

item.title: SPA hires Samantha Turi as director of commercial - IF Magazine
item.description: Screen Producers Australia (SPA) has appointed Samantha Turi as director of commercial as it looks to bolster support for producers working across more complex financing and rights environments.

item.title: 'Wolfram' (Trailer) - IF Magazine
item.description: The official trailer for Warwick Thornton’s 'Wolfram', set to be released in Australia on April 30, has been released alongside the announcement of a national Q&amp;A screening tour.

item.title: Screen Australia board welcomes Greg Sitch, as Marta Dusseldorp, Nicholas Pickard reappointed - IF Magazine
item.description: The Federal Government has appointed Greg Sitch to the Screen Australia board while reappointing actor and producer Marta Dusseldorp and APRA AMCOS executive director Nicholas Pickard, with all three to complete three-year terms.

item.title: IF Rising Talent 2026: Hair and makeup - IF Magazine
item.description: The future of Australian screen is looking good as IF Rising Talent 2026 turns to hair and makeup.

item.title: 'Narrow Road to the Deep North', 'Reckless' among Rockie Award nominees - IF Magazine
item.description: Australian titles spanning drama, audio, children's, and short form have been recognised in the 2026 Rockie Award nominations announced overnight.

item.title: 'Under a Bamboo Sky' (Trailer) - IF Magazine
item.description: Serge Ou documentary 'Under a Bamboo Sky', which uses new technology to bring to life a previously untold story of Australian WWII POWs, will receive a theatrical release via ABCG Film Distribution in collaboration with WildBear Entertainment.

item.title: Susie Jones named SPA Commissioner of the Year - IF Magazine
item.description: Screen Producers Australia (SPA) has named ABC head of documentary and specialist Susie Jones as its 2026 Commissioner of the Year.

item.title: Screen Australia backs 91 projects with $20.4m, including four short films - IF Magazine
item.description: Screen Australia has announced $20.4 million of production and development funding across 91 narrative projects, including the first four projects backed via its new short film production fund. Gary Hamaguchi’s Sundowner, Charlotte Mungomery’s The Novelty, Mark Wills’ Inferno and Haein Kim, Paul Rhodes and Robertino Zambrano’s Lazy Love (Lasagne 365) are the first shorts funded by Screen Australia in almost a decade, with the agency reinstating its support for the medium last year. item.title: Nick Waterman and Meg Washington in development on romantic musical 'Rosaleen' - IF Magazine
item.description: Nick Waterman and Meg Washington have announced their next feature collaboration, working with producer Schuyler Weiss on a romantic musical inspired by the "untold, scandalous affair behind the birth of the Sydney Opera House".

item.title: Creator groups hit back at education sector's copyright push - IF Magazine
item.description: A coalition of creator organisations and rights bodies, including Screenrights and the Australian Writers' Guild, has taken aim at the Schools Copyright Advisory Group, accusing it of running a long-standing campaign to undermine the licensing arrangements that ensure creators are paid for their work.

item.title: Screenworks brings Regional Crew Pathways back to Tasmania with Netflix, Screen Tasmania, AFTRS - IF Magazine
item.description: Screenworks is again inviting Tasmanians to participate in its Regional Pathways Program, which returns to the state in partnership with Netflix, Screen Tasmania, and AFTRS.

item.title: 'Glenn & Mick’s Celebrity Intervention' (First Look) - IF Magazine
item.description: 'Glenn & Mick’s Celebrity Intervention' features Mick Molloy and Glenn Robbins summoning some of their comedic friends to face the music as their loved ones, peers, and a few surprise guests gather to confront them about their “issues”.

item.title: 'We are constantly changing': SBS head of unscripted Joseph Maxwell on balancing distinctiveness with broad appeal - IF Magazine
item.description: A last month's AIDC, IF caught up with SBS head of unscripted Joseph Maxwell discusses the broadcaster's documentary commissioning priorities, its response to a pitch dispute, and how it plans to leverage World Cup audiences across its factual slate.

item.title: Government unveils National Cultural Policy advisory group, expert panels - IF Magazine
item.description: The CEOs of Screen Australia, AFTRS, and APRA AMCOS will form part of the nine-member Policy Advisory Group for the next National Cultural Policy, as the government unveils the five expert panels that will guide the new strategy.
